subject: AWS Offer readiness: pricing matrix, trial CTA, and regional AMI checklist
messages:
From: Jenny Morales <jenny@cloudscale.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS listing kickoff + a quick checklist request

Hi Olga and Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at CloudScale is excited about Redwood as an option for inference in our managed offering. We're starting internal prep for the AWS listing and need a short checklist from you to move into procurement and marketplace approvals. Specifically: 

- Finalized one-liner and 50-word summary for the product page
- Preferred pricing tiers and trial/PrivateOffer guidance (any constraints)
- AMI tagging guidance and regional AMI mapping (we have EU + US-East use cases)
- Any compliance claims or evidence snippets we should surface on the listing

I've attached our internal asset bundle and the current AMI inventory (sample) for reference. Can you send a consolidated list by end of day Wednesday? Procurement wants to lock language before we open a PrivateOffer.

Cheers,

Jenny Morales
Head of Cloud Procurement | CloudScale Solutions
jenny@cloudscale.com

Attachments: aws_listing_assets_v2.pdf (pdf), sample-ami-tags.csv (csv)
From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Morales <jenny@cloudscale.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + a quick checklist request

Hi Jenny — great to hear and congrats on moving this forward. Quick plan below; I'll own collating the copy and assets. Rafael and Kimberly are looped in for pricing and AMI/ops specifics.

High-level deliverables (will send consolidated PDF + Drive link):
1) Product copy options (one-liner + 50-word): two variants — "developer-focused" and "enterprise-ops".
2) Pricing recommendations: list + example PrivateOffer footnote language. Rafael will propose a 3-tier and an hourly v. token example.
3) AMI/region notes: sample tags we recommend, and recommended approach for EU images (bring-your-own AMI vs shared AMI).
4) Compliance snippets: SOC2 + data residency note and a short audit-evidence list for the listing page.

Action items:
- Kimberly: pricing and PrivateOffer constraints (by Tue EOD).
- Rafael: AMI tag mapping and ops notes (by Tue EOD).
- Olga: assemble copy and produce final asset bundle + one Drive link (Wed noon).

Do you have a preferred DocuSign or approval workflow we should expect from AWS side? That'll help us sequence internal approvals.

Thanks — speaking cadence OK here? If you'd like, we can do a 20-min call Tues to walk the PrivateOffer flow.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenny Morales <jenny@cloudscale.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + a quick checklist request

Thanks — jumping in on pricing. Rafael and I synced briefly this morning. Quick notes to include in the consolidated doc:

- Suggested SKU tiers: Starter (small-scale POC) | Growth (predictable throughput) | Dedicated (reserved). Example pricing rows included in attached pricing-matrix.xlsx.
- Trial CTA: recommend a 30-day private offer trial coupon (code-based) tied to a 90-day usage cap to avoid unexpected spend. Language for page: "Start a free 30-day Private Offer trial — limits apply."
- Footnote language for metering: "Billing is per inference-hour; token-equivalent estimates provided in the pricing table." (we can switch to tokens if the buyer prefers token billing).
- PrivateOffer constraints: need CloudScale's account ID for seller accepted PrivateOffers and a linked PO for procurement (ProcureIT usually raises the PO after DocuSign).

I've attached the pricing spreadsheet with sample numbers. Rafael — can you confirm AMI tagging and whether we should recommend shared AMIs in EU vs BYO? I prefer recommending BYO with an explicit AMI mapping doc for regulated accounts.

Kimberly Park
Marketplace & GTM | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Morales <jenny@cloudscale.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + a quick checklist request

Looping back with AMI recommendations and the ops checklist. Summary below (full CSV attached).

- EU images: recommend BYO AMI for now. Shared AMIs in EU regions introduce additional residency+compliance checks; BYO simplifies procurement for regulated customers.
- Tagging convention (recommended): product=redwood-inference; version=YYYYMMDD; region=us-east-1 (example); build=quantized-v2. Attach: sample-ami-tags.csv.
- Ops checklist for listing: pre-signed URLs for installers (if any), quickstart README link, maximum supported sequence length (for product claims), and an uptime/SLA blurb.
- Compliance snippets: SOC2 Type II, data-in-transit encryption, and note on optional customer-managed KMS for Private deployments.

Next steps: Olga to land the copy with the two one-liner variants and the 50-word summaries; Kimberly to confirm final numbers in pricing-matrix.xlsx; Jenny/CloudScale to confirm whether PrivateOffer trial code or trial account will be used.

Rafael Mendes
Infrastructure Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Attachments: sample-ami-tags.csv (csv)
